title: 12 Best Chopped Cheese in New York City (2026)
description: The best chopped cheese sandwiches in NYC — from the bodega that invented it to Korean-American twists and Wagyu upgrades. Curated from hundreds of Reddit recommendations.

picks.name: Blue Sky Deli (Hajji's)
picks.verdict: The bodega with the strongest claim to inventing the chopped cheese. Simple, classic, loaded with sazón.
picks.whatToOrder: The chopped cheese (classic, with everything). Grab a soda and a bag of red hot chips.

picks.name: Nishaan
picks.verdict: Pakistani-American flavors — cumin, coriander, lime-cilantro sauce, and tamarind chutney — make this unforgettable.
picks.whatToOrder: The chopped cheese with everything. Their lime-cilantro sauce is the star.

picks.name: Titi's Empanadas
picks.verdict: Hard-seared beef with crunchy textures and a herby green sauce. Open until 2am on weekends.
picks.whatToOrder: Chopped cheese with their green sauce. Also grab an empanada.

picks.name: Cubby's
picks.verdict: Off-menu chopped cheese on pillowy burger rolls with pickled jalapeños for acidity and heat.
picks.whatToOrder: The chopped cheese (off-menu, just ask). Add a malt for fry dipping.

picks.name: Bodega Truck
picks.verdict: A bodega on wheels with a stuffed cat on the counter. The OG chopped cheese is a gooey, salty masterpiece.
picks.whatToOrder: The OG chopped cheese — ground beef, cheese, lettuce, tomato, bodega sauce.

picks.name: Compton's
picks.verdict: The fanciest chopped cheese on this list — on a crusty sesame semolina loaf. You can play Pac-Man while you wait.
picks.whatToOrder: The chopped cheese on semolina. Add crunchy iceberg lettuce.

picks.name: Blue Hour
picks.verdict: Halal chopped cheese inside a Bushwick gas station with a warm spice blend different from standard sazón.
picks.whatToOrder: The chopped cheese. Embrace the gas station vibes.

picks.name: Nowon East Village
picks.verdict: Chopped Cheese Rice Cakes — spiced beef, soy-pickled jalapeños, and parmesan on Korean rice cakes.

picks.name: Prospect Park Deli
picks.verdict: Reddit's favorite Wagyu chopped cheese. A neighborhood bodega near Prospect Park doing premium beef.
picks.whatToOrder: The Wagyu chopped cheese with everything.

picks.name: CR Gourmet Deli
picks.verdict: A 24-hour East Village deli with a cult following. Ask for the 'Milo' signature chopped cheese.
picks.whatToOrder: The 'Milo' chopped cheese — the signature version with everything.

picks.name: Olympia Star Deli and Juice
picks.verdict: Yelp's #1 for chopped cheese in NYC. A Chelsea deli that nails the classic format.
picks.whatToOrder: Classic chopped cheese with everything. Add a fresh juice.

picks.name: Pink's Cantina
picks.verdict: The chopped cheese burrito. Ground beef and American cheese inside a burrito — it works.
picks.whatToOrder: The Chopped Cheese Burrito. Ask for lettuce and tomato added.
